title: Practitioner Exam
description: 12 questions covering Pentaho 11 installation, components, ports, prerequisites, and post-install tasks. Pass mark is 80%. Open-book — browse any module to refresh your memory or ask the AI assistant for help. Your answers are saved as you go, so leaving the page to look something up is fine. Explanations show after submission so you can learn from any answers you missed.

questions.prompt: Pentaho 11 ships as a coordinated release of which two products?
questions.explanation: Pentaho 11 bundles PDI 11.0 (Pentaho Data Integration) and PBA 11.0 (Pentaho Business Analytics) on the same release cadence.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Overview — What's New

questions.scenario: You are about to provision a fresh Linux host for an archive install and need to pick an OS that the install labs and apt commands assume.
questions.prompt: Which Linux baseline does Pentaho 11.x officially support for archive installation?
questions.explanation: The supported baseline is Ubuntu 24.04 LTS — the Prepare Environment lab and its apt / /etc/environment commands assume it.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Overview — Components Reference

questions.scenario: A prospect downloads the public Pentaho EE build to evaluate it before purchasing.
questions.prompt: How long is the Enterprise Edition evaluation license that ships with the public download?
questions.explanation: The free EE download includes a 30-day trial license. GA binaries from the Customer Portal instead need an Activation ID or licensing URL.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Getting Started — Support Portal & Licensing

questions.prompt: Which Java version does Pentaho 11 require?
questions.explanation: Prepare Environment installs OpenJDK 21 and sets PENTAHO_JAVA_HOME to it. Pentaho 11 is certified on Java 21.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Archive Installation — Prepare Environment

questions.scenario: Ubuntu 24.04's default repository ships PostgreSQL 16, but you need a version certified for the Pentaho 11 repository.
questions.prompt: Which PostgreSQL versions are supported as Pentaho's repository database in Pentaho 11?
questions.explanation: Pentaho 11 supports PostgreSQL 15 and 17. The lab adds the PGDG repository to install PostgreSQL 17 plus pgAdmin 4.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Archive Installation — Prepare Environment

questions.prompt: Which port does the Pentaho Server's Tomcat use as its HTTP startup port by default?
questions.explanation: Tomcat's HTTP listener is 8080. The shutdown port is 8012, HSQL is 9001, the embedded H2 database is 9092, and PostgreSQL is 5432.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Getting Started — Components

questions.scenario: Following the install procedure, you provision a dedicated account so the Pentaho files and running server are isolated from your personal login.
questions.prompt: What is the dedicated Linux user the install procedure creates to own the Pentaho directories?
questions.explanation: Prepare Environment creates a pentaho user with sudo. Files under $PENTAHO_BASE are owned by it and the server runs as it.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Archive Installation — Prepare Environment

questions.prompt: Which environment variable identifies the root of the Pentaho install on Linux?
questions.explanation: $PENTAHO_BASE (set in /etc/environment to /opt/pentaho) is used throughout the install commands so paths stay consistent.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Archive Installation — Prepare Environment

questions.scenario: You want to run PDI artifacts from the shell in a scheduled batch job rather than from the Spoon GUI.
questions.prompt: Which TWO command-line tools execute PDI transformations and jobs from the shell?
questions.explanation: Pan runs transformations (.ktr) and Kitchen runs jobs (.kjb). Carte is the lightweight remote-execution server; Spoon is the GUI.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Getting Started — Components (Pan / Kitchen)

questions.prompt: Which Pentaho component is a lightweight Jetty-based web server for remote execution and clustering of jobs and transformations?
questions.explanation: Carte is a Jetty-based server exposing a REST API for remote execution and clustering, letting you scale ETL across machines.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Getting Started — Components (Carte)

questions.scenario: During an archive install you extend the Pentaho Server with the standard EE analytics plugins from the Plugin Manager.
questions.prompt: Which TWO of these are genuine Pentaho Server EE plugins?
questions.explanation: paz (Analyzer) and pdd (Dashboard Designer) are real EE plugins, alongside pir, webttle, semantic-model-editor and pas-scheduler. Tomcat's manager and the Repository Browser are not Pentaho plugins.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Archive Installation — Server Plugins

questions.prompt: Which content repository does the Pentaho Server use to store reports, dashboards, and ETL assets?
options: Apache Jackrabbit, backed by a relational database
A Git repository on the server
questions.explanation: Content lives in an Apache Jackrabbit JCR repository backed by a supported relational database (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, Oracle, MySQL, or MariaDB). The Repository Browser in Spoon connects to the same store.
questions.source: Pentaho Installation - Practitioner: Archive Installation — Install Pentaho Server (Repository)
